domain-information: A client provides a project brief to the creative producer.
A client reviews the initial project plan and sends revision requests.
A client approves the final storyboard before production begins.
A creative producer receives a project brief and creates a project plan.
A creative producer coordinates with the art director to set the visual direction.
A creative producer updates the client on project progress.
An art director reviews the project plan and assigns concept artists to create sketches.
An art director approves the sketch art before he passes it to a storyboard artist.
A storyboard artist creates storyboard frames based on the approved concept art.
A storyboard artist updates the storyboard when feedback comes from the art director.
An animator receives the approved storyboard and produces animated sequences.
An animator submits completed animation shots to the production manager for review.
A production manager reviews submitted shots and sends revision requests back to animators when needed.
A production manager compiles all final animation shots for quality review.
A quality reviewer checks the final compiled animation and approves it for client delivery.

domain objects.name: Client
domain objects.description: External party requesting the animation project.

domain objects.name: Project Brief
domain objects.description: Initial description of the client’s project needs.

domain objects.name: Creative Producer
domain objects.description: Person responsible for planning and coordinating the project.

domain objects.name: Revision Request
domain objects.description: Feedback asking for changes to project work.

domain objects.name: Final Storyboard
domain objects.description: Approved storyboard used for production.

domain objects.name: Storyboard Frame
domain objects.description: A single illustrated frame within the storyboard.

domain objects.name: Project Plan
domain objects.description: Structured plan of tasks, resources, and timeline.

domain objects.name: Visual Direction
domain objects.description: Guidelines defining the project’s artistic style.

domain objects.name: Project Update
domain objects.description: Status information sent to the client.

domain objects.name: Art Director
domain objects.description: Person overseeing artistic direction and quality.

domain objects.name: Concept Artist
domain objects.description: Artist creating early visual sketches for direction.

domain objects.name: Sketch
domain objects.description: Initial artwork created to establish visual ideas.

domain objects.name: Storyboard Artist
domain objects.description: Artist creating the storyboard from sketches.

domain objects.name: Feedback
domain objects.description: Art director’s guidance for improvements.

domain objects.name: Animator
domain objects.description: Artist producing animated sequences from the storyboard.

domain objects.name: Sequence
domain objects.description: A produced segment of animation.

domain objects.name: Production Manager
domain objects.description: Person reviewing animation work and coordinating revisions.

domain objects.name: Final Animation
domain objects.description: Collection of approved sequences forming the final piece.

domain objects.name: Client Delivery
domain objects.description: The package of final animation sent to the client.

domain objects.name: Quality Reviewer
domain objects.description: Person conducting the final quality check.

associations.description: Client provides the Project Brief.
Project Brief is received by Creative Producer.
Creative Producer creates the Project Plan.
Client reviews the Project Plan.
Client issues a Revision Request.
Revision Request is sent to Creative Producer.
Creative Producer creates a Project Update.
Project Update is sent to Client.
Creative Producer defines initial Visual Direction.
Art Director finalizes the Visual Direction.
Art Director reviews the Project Plan.
Art Director creates Feedback.
Feedback is sent to Storyboard Artist.
Art Director approves the Final Storyboard.
Client approves the Final Storyboard.
Concept Artist creates Sketch.
Art Director assigns work to Concept Artist.
Art Director passes approved Sketches to Storyboard Artist.
Storyboard Artist uses Sketch as input.
Storyboard Artist creates Storyboard Frame.
Final Storyboard is provided to Animator.
Animator produces a Sequence.
Production Manager reviews the Sequence.
Production Manager sends Revision Request.
Revision Request is sent to Animator.
Production Manager compiles the Final Animation.
Quality Reviewer reviews the Final Animation.
Quality Reviewer approves Client Delivery.
Client Delivery is sent to Client.
